name: Visdynamics Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年，Visdynamics Holdings Berhad 未公告新的业务扩张、新业务进入、缩减或出售事项；期间公告主要为季度业绩、公司秘书变更、地址变更、股东大会及股息除权安排。最新一季（截至2026年7月31日）营收为12,354,000令吉，同比增57.5%；净利润为3,764,000令吉，同比增294.5%。
overview_en: In 2026, Visdynamics Holdings Berhad did not announce any new business expansion, entry into new businesses, reduction, or disposal. Its announcements during the year mainly covered quarterly results, changes of company secretary, change of address, general meetings, and dividend entitlement. For the latest quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was RM12,354,000, up 57.5% year-on-year; net profit was RM3,764,000, up 294.5% year-on-year.
